hero.label: — Ho Chi Minh City · Vietnam
hero.sub: BJJ black belt teaching MMA, boxing, kickboxing and self-defense in Ho Chi Minh City. Private sessions, one on one, built around what you actually need.
hero.alt: Fighter wrapping his hands in a dark studio

disciplines.label: — What I teach
disciplines.title: Five disciplines. One approach.
disciplines.intro: Every technique gets taught with the same question behind it: does this hold up when someone is actually resisting? That filter decides what makes it into a session and what gets left out.

items.name: Self defense
items.desc: Practical skills for real-world situations. What works when there are no rules and no referee.

items.name: Boxing
items.desc: Fundamentals, combinations and fight IQ. Reading distance before throwing.

items.name: Kickboxing
items.desc: Power, technique and conditioning. Kicks that land and kicks that don't get caught.

items.name: Jiu-jitsu
items.desc: Control, submissions and ground game. Gi and no-gi.

items.name: Private coaching
items.desc: One on one, built around your goals. Beginner to competitor.

private.label: — Training in Ho Chi Minh
private.title: Private sessions.
private.body: Sessions are one on one, built around where you are now and where you want to get. No fixed curriculum, no class you have to keep up with. If you've never trained, we start from zero. If you compete, we work on what's failing.
private.caption: Training session · Ho Chi Minh City
private.mailBody: Hi, I'd like to book a private session. Here's what I want to work on:

library.label: — Free to learn
library.title: Technique breakdowns.
library.body: Every week I break down a technique and show why it fails more often than it should. Free, on Instagram and TikTok.

about.label: — Who's teaching
about.title: Real World
about.p1: BJJ black belt. Boxing, kickboxing and self-defense. Years of training that started long before any of this ended up on a phone screen.
about.p2: Moved to Ho Chi Minh City in 2026 with family, and now teaches here — private sessions and club classes.
about.p3: The approach is the same one in every video: strip the technique down to the detail that decides it. Most things fail for one small reason. Find that, fix that.
about.alt: Instructor in a white gi with a black belt

gear.label: — What I use
gear.title: Gear that holds up.
gear.body: Gloves, shin guards, wraps and grip equipment I actually train with. Affiliate links — same price for you.
gear.disclosure: Affiliate links. Same price for you — I get a small commission.

booking.label: — Ho Chi Minh City
booking.body: Tell me what you want to work on. We figure out the rest from there.
